title: A Preliminary Glimpse of the Heavenly Realm Powers
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to blend into the crowd, a cold divine sense quietly locked onto him—among the opposition faction, someone had already noticed the presence of this uninvited guest.

text.content: The moment the gatekeeper fell, a more powerful aura arrived from the distance. That aura was vast as an abyss, carrying a heart-stopping pressure, like an ancient beast awakening from slumber, slowly opening its eyes. Chen Ji's pupils constricted slightly, yet he showed no panic; instead, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly—this was the answer he sought. Since the Heavenly Gate had opened for him, the real test would naturally follow.

He didn't choose to resist directly; the instant that aura approached, his form transformed into a lingering shadow and swept into the Heavenly Gate. The golden radiance of the portal gradually closed behind him, temporarily isolating that oppressive force. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, raised his head to survey the scene before him, a barely concealed shock flickering across his features—this was the Heavenly Realm?

dialogue.content: Here... truly bore no resemblance to the mortal realm.

text.content: Beneath his feet lay an ethereal sea of clouds, yet it firmly bore his weight; overhead, no sun hung, but gentle radiance scattered from all directions; what filled the air wasn't spiritual energy but something more pristine, closer to origin—the Dao Rhyme. With each breath, Chen Ji sensed his cultivation stirring, as if this very realm was nurturing him.

Yet what alarmed him more were three distinctly different auras from afar. The first aura was the most expansive, like an eternal sun that never fell, domineering and blatant, as if proclaiming something; the second aura was cold and treacherous, concealed in shadow, like a venomous serpent lying in wait; the third aura was the faintest, barely perceptible, as if it might dissipate at any moment, yet inspired Chen Ji's deepest wariness.

dialogue.content: The Ultimate Chess Player Faction, the Opposition, the Watchers... exactly as Mo Xiansheng had said, the situation in the Heavenly Realm was far more complex than he had imagined.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his aura, disguising himself as an ordinary newcomer to the Heavenly Realm, and walked slowly toward the nearest floating city. The city gates stood wide open, cultivators coming and going in an endless stream, yet no one questioned his identity. He mingled with the crowd, observing his surroundings while pricking up his ears to catch fragments of conversation. Information—that was what he needed most now.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) Interesting... these people mention the Opposition even more frequently than the Ultimate Chess Player Faction. It seems this game is far more complicated than I anticipated.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needed to decide how to position his first move among these three major forces.

choices.description: Seek opportunities to approach members of the Ultimate Chess Player Faction to quickly obtain core intelligence about the Heavenly Realm.
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chess Player Faction has numerous eyes and ears; high risk of exposure

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze swept through the crowd, quickly locking onto several cultivators with extraordinary auras wearing special emblems on their chests—that should be the emblem of the Ultimate Chess Player Faction. He straightened his robe, walked over slowly, wearing a perfectly measured humble smile.

dialogue.content: Fellow Daoists, please stay a moment—I have recently entered the Heavenly Realm and have many things I don't understand, hoping you might kindly offer guidance.

choices.description: Conceal one's form and thoroughly investigate the true scale and layout of the Opposition.
choices.visible_reward: Gain More Comprehensive Intelligence on the Factions
choices.risk_hint: The Opposition May Have Detection Methods

text.content: Chen Ji quietly withdrew from the city gate, his form merging into the sea of clouds, activating concealment techniques to suppress his aura to near nothingness. He took a wide detour, approaching from the flank toward where the Opposition's aura was most concentrated, and began meticulous observation.

dialogue.content: (Transmitting to Mo Xiansheng) Mo Xiansheng, do you sense it? The scale of this Opposition... seems far larger than the intelligence indicated.

choices.description: Appearing with absolute confidence, directly declaring his arrival to the three factions.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke hostility from all three factions simultaneously
choices.visible_reward: Quickly establish status, drawing attention from all sides
choices.risk_hint: Highest risk, but also the greatest reward

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. Since he had come to the Heavenly Realm, why should he hold back? He took a deep breath and abruptly released an aura pressure strong enough to suffocate ordinary cultivators—the scent of the Tianji Record Fragment, carrying the unique mark of the Law of Destiny.

dialogue.content: Citizens of the Heavenly Realm, Chen Ji has arrived—if you wish to meet, feel free to show yourselves.

text.content: At that moment, an elusive will swept across Chen Ji's position. That will was cold and lofty, devoid of any emotion, yet it sent a chill down his spine—the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Chen Ji tensed, knowing that the moment he entered the Heavenly Realm, he had already entered that being's field of vision.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) So this is the will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao... Just as Mo Xiansheng said, it watches everything I do. But this precisely proves I'm on the right path.

text.content: Chen Ji continued deeper into the floating city. The architectural style here was entirely different from the mortal realm, each structure containing profound Heavenly Laws. Simply standing within them, one could feel their cultivation slowly increasing. The cultivators on the streets were of all kinds—some with pure auras, some radiating evil energy, others unfathomable. The Heavenly Realm was indeed a convergence point of all realms.

However, when Chen Ji rounded a massive plaza and reached the other side of the city, his pupils contracted sharply. In the distance, the area where the Opposition gathered was far more magnificent than the Ultimate Chess Master's faction—dark masses of people, layered auras, and faint battle formations... This was no mere opposition force, but an army capable of conquering an entire realm!

dialogue.content: This scale... The Ultimate Chess Master's faction's intelligence had clearly been concealing something. Or perhaps they themselves didn't know the true strength of the Opposition.

text.content: Chen Ji quickly retreated to a hidden corner and began rapidly analyzing the current situation. The Opposition's scale exceeded imagination, meaning the Heavenly Realm's structure was far more complex than he had anticipated. In this game of chess, blindly choosing sides was foolish—he needed more information to make the most advantageous decision for himself.

choice.prompt: The true scale of the Opposition shocked Chen Ji, and now he needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Take a risk to approach the Opposition's core area and obtain more detailed intelligence.
choices.risk_hint: The Opposition's core area is heavily guarded

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, activating a fraction of the Tianji Record's power to disguise his aura as that of the Opposition, slowly approaching the dark mass of people. With each step, he felt cultivators' auras passing by him—fortunately, no one paid him excessive attention.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) The Tianji Record's aura... indeed useful. As long as I don't encounter true experts, I won't be exposed.

choices.description: Collect information from the periphery, searching for the Opposition's weak points.
choices.visible_reward: Discover the contradictions between the Opposition and the Ultimate Chess Master's faction

text.content: Chen Ji did not rashly venture deeper, but chose an excellent observation point—the second floor of a half-abandoned tavern. From here, he could clearly see the entire opposition camp while drawing minimal attention. He ordered a pot of inferior spiritual tea and began to quietly observe and listen.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Interesting... The cultivators of the opposition don't seem as united as one might imagine. In their eyes, there is anxiety, confusion, and... anger?

text.content: As Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, the tavern servant brought fresh spiritual tea. The servant was a seemingly harmless young man, but Chen Ji acutely sensed a subtle scrutiny in his gaze. The moment he took the teacup, his fingertips inadvertently brushed against the servant's hand—the touch of a cultivator, far from an ordinary mortal.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) This tavern servant... is no simple person. Is he from the opposition, a scout of the Ultimate Chess Player faction? Or perhaps... an agent of the Eye of Heavenly Ways?

text.content: Chen Ji calmly set down the teacup, his gaze透过窗户，继续观察着远处的反对派阵营。在那里，他注意到了一个有趣的现象：反对派的cultivator虽然人数众多，但他们的眼神中普遍带着一种特殊的情绪——那是被压迫者特有的furious与不甘。这不是一群想要造反的暴徒，而是一群被逼到绝境的可怜人。

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) I understand now... The Ultimate Chess Player faction, or rather the Eye of Heavenly Ways, views these people as chess pieces, manipulating them at will. And the opposition is precisely the rebellion of these pieces. No wonder they say the opposition is larger than intelligence suggested—because every day, more are awakening.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needed to decide how to utilize this new discovery.

choices.description: Find opportunities to connect with key figures in the opposition and probe the possibility of cooperation.
choices.risk_hint: The opposition maintains high vigilance toward newcomers

text.content: Chen Ji set down his teacup and rose to leave the tavern. He did not walk directly toward the opposition's core area, but wandered the peripheral edges, searching for a suitable point of entry. Finally, a solitary opposition cultivator caught his attention—the person sat alone in a secluded corner, expression filled with desolation.

dialogue.content: Fellow Daoist, you seem troubled? I too am newly arrived. If you don't mind, shall we converse?

choices.description: Stay put, continue observing, gather more intelligence before making decisions.
choices.risk_hint: The situation may change at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, not rushing to act. He returned to the tavern's second floor, continuing to observe the opposition's movements. In this complex situation, one wrong step could mean total defeat. He needed more information to make the most correct judgment.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) No rush... The real show has just begun.

choices.description: Spread information unfavorable to the Ultimate Chess Player faction, intensifying the opposition's anger.
choices.visible_reward: The situation was developing in a direction favorable to himself.
choices.risk_hint: Might be traced back to its source.

text.content: A bold plan took shape in Chen Ji's mind as a slight smile curved his lips. He slipped out of the tavern quietly, making his way to the edge of a crowded plaza where he merged into the throng. Seizing the moment when no one was paying attention, he released words in the lowest of voices—words sufficient to shake people's hearts—about the truth of the Ultimate Chess Master's recent purge.

dialogue.content: (Transmitting voice, only specific people can hear) Do you know? The so-called rebellion last time was actually orchestrated by the Ultimate Chess Master... those who were killed were all innocent.

text.content: However, just as Chen Ji thought everything was going smoothly, he suddenly felt a cold spiritual sense lock onto him from the crowd. The master of that spiritual sense possessed cultivation depths that were unfathomable, bringing with it an asphyxiating pressure—among the opposition, someone had already taken note of his presence, and this person was definitely no ordinary cultivator.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) Not good... being watched. This person's aura... is even more terrifying than I imagined. Is it a leader of the opposition, or... an eye of the Ultimate Chess Master?

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but in his heart he had already prepared to retreat at any moment. He slowly turned around, trying to catch the master of that spiritual sense with his peripheral vision. In the crowd, a figure in black robes was walking toward where he stood—the person's face hidden beneath a hood, yet every step seemed to step on Chen Ji's heartstrings, carrying an inexplicable sense of familiarity.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) This person... gives me a strange feeling. Like a crucial node in fate, yet I can't recall where I've seen them.

text.content: Just as that black-robed figure was about to reach Chen Ji, an even more terrifying aura descended from the void. That aura was cold, vast, and lofty, as if Heavenly Secrets itself was observing everything here—it was the will of the Eye of Heavenly Way! At this moment, it intervened in this impending confrontation.

Chen Ji felt that familiar pressure, yet his heart was unexpectedly calm. The gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way came at just the right moment—this was both crisis and opportunity. He decided to seize this chaos to quietly disappear into the crowd. As for that mysterious black-robed figure... next time they met, he would definitely get to the bottom of their identity.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) Interesting... does the Eye of Heavenly Way's intervention want to protect me, or test me? Or perhaps... it wants to see just how far I can go? Regardless, this move, I've noted it down.

text.content: His figure flickering, Chen Ji had already vanished from where he stood. When he appeared again, he was in a remote cave at the edge of the Heavenly Realm. He sat cross-legged and began to sort through all the intelligence he had gained today. The structure of the Heavenly Realm was more complex than he had imagined, with the three major powers each harboring their own calculations, while he himself sought his own opportunities in this game.

The scale of the opposition exceeded imagination, meaning they possessed sufficient power to shake the entire structure of the Heavenly Realm. The Ultimate Chess Master appeared formidable, yet in truth had to face challenges from the opposition and pressure from the Eye of Heavenly Way. As for the neutral observers... their existence itself was a mystery, but Chen Ji faintly sensed that this force might be the key to the entire situation.

Just as Chen Ji was deep in contemplation, a voice rang out in his mind—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice, aged and profound: "Your actions today were somewhat reckless. However... this old man seems to have encountered that black-robed person's aura somewhere before. This matter, you must investigate and clarify as soon as possible." Chen Ji opened his eyes and nodded. In the next chapter, he must get to the bottom of that mysterious black-robed figure's identity—for that person might be the key to changing the entire structure of the Heavenly Realm.

Outside the cave, the light of the Heavenly Realm remained soft and bright. Yet beneath this tranquil surface, undercurrents churned. Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. He was waiting, waiting for the moment when that black-robed figure would appear again. And in some corner of the Heavenly Realm, that mysterious black-robed figure was also gazing toward the cave—beneath the hood, a pair of eyes brimming with complex emotions was revealed, seeming to recall some ancient past.
